messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: R-squared change approaches in Hayes (2021)
parts: could someone translate "Approach 3: Direct matrix calculation of 𝑅2𝑅𝑒𝑑𝑢𝑐𝑒𝑑" and "Approach 4: Specifying ξ 2 as a saturated correlate in the reduced model" from Hayes (2021) into lavaan syntax for SEM models?
Hayes T. provides the Mplus code only

The author provides R functions in the appendices for Approach 3, with examples of how to use them in 3 R syntax files (using lavaan) in the electronic supplementary materials (ESM 6 7 and 8).

Approach 4 simply replaces a regression path with a covariance.  So if your model has 2 latent predictors "ksi1" and "ksi2" of a latent outcome "eta":

eta ~ ksi1 + ksi2
ksi1 ~~ ksi2 # estimated by default using sem(), or set auto.cov.lv.x=TRUE

Then you would compare that R-squared with one from an equivalent model where ksi2 is not a predictor (but is still correlated with eta's residual):

eta ~ ksi1
ksi2 ~~ ksi1 + eta
